# oracle-desk

> Self-custody autonomous trading desk for Solana launches: radar, research seats, risk desk, execution, audit loop and a head of desk that fires losing strategies. Paper by default.

oracle-desk is an open-source repository by nirholas, part of the three.ws ecosystem.
